Synechron	Jul 2024 – Present

Data Scientist - Senior Associate	Bangalore

CodeSense – AI-powered code analysis platform(Internal Accelerator).

Developed a scalable asynchronous architecture with GitLab webhooks and Azure OpenAI, automating bug detection, test case generation, and enhancement suggestions across 20+ repositories.

Built GitLab–Jira workflow automation with async pipelines that analyze requirements against implementation and generate markdown reports.

Integrated SonarQube for static analysis with parallel processing and caching, reducing review cycles from days to hours and enhancing developer productivity by ∼ 35%.

AskJeff – Conversational AI for research documents.

Built a RAG-based document chatbot using AWS-native services, enabling context-aware Q&A on internal research papers and accelerating literature review workflows.

Implemented a fully automated document ingestion and chunking pipeline with embeddings stored in pgvector store for efficient semantic retrieval.

CollegeDekho	Feb 2024 – Jun 2024

Data Scientist	Gurgaon

SaarthiGPT – GenAI Chat Interface for Colleges and Exam Details

Developed a Generative AI chat-based assistant by implementing a RAG pipeline using Haystack, to provide information on admissions, exams, and other college details with ∼ 90% accuracy.

Automated an ETL pipeline to extract unstructured university data (PDFs/HTML), transform it into structured text, load it into AWS S3, and index it in Elasticsearch for efficient retrieval.

Mapping Algorithm : Designed and implemented an NLP-based mapping algorithm to accurately match college and course names across disparate data sources, achieving ∼ 93% accuracy.

Climate Bonds Initiative	Mar 2023 – Feb 2024

Data Scientist(Contract)	London, UK (Remote)

Portfolio Assessment Tool - Sustainable Finance Taxonomy Classification

Developed end-to-end automated ML pipeline using ensemble approach to classify 10,000+ investment projects against 4 international sustainability frameworks (EU Taxonomy, MDB, ICMA, CBI) with

~ 85% accuracy while reducing manual assessment effort and TAT by ∼ 90%.

Containerized and deployed the solution on AWS (Docker + EC2/ECR) with CI/CD integration (GitHub Actions), ensuring scalability and consistency across environments.

Axis Bank – Business Intelligence Unit	Jul 2021 – Mar 2023

Business Analytics Manager – Small Business Banking Loans, Cross Sell Team	Bangalore

Business Lending Scorecard : Developed a credit risk score model for Axis Bank’s merchant base using



Weight of Evidence (WOE) and Logistic Regression in PySpark, enabling data-driven lending decisions.



Automated monthly customer base and funnel creation using SAS - PROC SQL, developed executive dashboards for tracking SBB Risk KPIs, and performed customer segmentation analysis to design targeted cross-sell strategies.

Urban Ladder	Oct 2020 – Jun 2021

Business Excellence: Business Intelligence Analytics and Product Management(Contract)	Bangalore (Remote)

oracUL(order management tracking system) : Mapped Inventory Lifecycle and process flows, Conducted user research. Conceptualized features and metrics and created PRD. Improving overall inventory availability by ∼ 30%, high-priority availability by ∼ 26%, cutting replenishment cycle time by 2 days(avg), and reducing out-of-stock cases by ∼ 70%.

Reorder Engine(integrated with oracUL) : Developed a time series–based demand forecasting model and alert engine for inventory replenishment, and developed a vendor scorecard to evaluate quarterly vendor performance along with dashboards to track inventory health and performance across categories.

College dunia Web Pvt Ltd	Nov 2019 – Feb 2020

Business Analyst	Gurgaon

Developed counsellor scorecards and improved online counselling efficiency via call analysis. Designed targeted email marketing campaigns for lead nurturing, boosting sales by ∼ 18%, reduced churn by ∼ 20%.

Technical Skills

Programming Languages: Python, PySpark, SQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, FastAPI

GenAI: LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, CrewAI, Fireworks, Perplexity, Huggingface, Agentic AI

Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB(NoSQL), Elasticsearch

Business Intelligence Tools: Tableau, SAS, Advanced Excel, Google Colab, SiSense, Asana, JIRA

Cloud Services and MLOps: AWS, Docker, Azure AI, Github Actions, MLFlow

Projects

Ecom Express Pvt Ltd | Data Science Internship	Gurgaon, Jul’19 – Nov’19

Network Design Optimization : Applied K-means clustering for network design optimization of 2500 delivery centres. Built OSRM-backend instance(routing engine) on AWS EC2 for distance and routing calculations and benchmarked it against Google Maps API, reducing annual costs by ∼ 2 cr and improving computation time by ∼ 84%.

Built Time Series Forecasting models (ARIMA, SARIMA, LSTM, Prophet, FFT) to predict demand across 2,500 delivery centres, validating accuracy with k-fold cross-validation.

Cranfield University | Research Summer Intern (School of Aerospace)	London(UK), May’17 – Jul’17

Thermal Management and Performance Simulation of a Geared Turbofan Engine.

Extracurricular

Teaching volunteer at National Service Scheme(NSS), BITS Pilani.

Football, Backpacking, Music/Guitar, Reading
